_readme: HANGOVER event location — the ONLY place the venue is defined.
The homepage, the Event Location section, the Get Directions button, the map, the footer, the PDF tickets and the confirmation emails all read this file.
Changes apply immediately (no restart needed) as long as the JSON stays valid.
confirmed: true  -> the venue below is shown everywhere.
confirmed: false -> every page shows comingSoonMessage instead, and the map / Get Directions button are hidden.
venueName + address = the WRITTEN venue shown to guests (e.g. 'Adjirigano, behind Beirut Cafe, Accra, Ghana').
mapQuery = what the MAP PIN and Get Directions search for. It is kept separate on purpose: here it points at the landmark (Beirut Cafe) itself.
mapNote = small text shown beside the map explaining what the pin marks.
directionsUrl / embedUrl: optional full https:// links that override the automatic Google Maps links (e.g. a pinned Google Maps share link of the landmark).
No GPS coordinates are used or invented.
mapNote: The map pin marks Beirut Cafe, the landmark. The venue is behind it.
